and name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and id like concat(#{id},'%')
select course_id, capacity, number_of_applicant from course_capacity where course_id=#{courseId} for update
select course_id, date_format(date,'%Y%m') AS salesMonth, count(*) AS count from class_room_schedule where course_id=#{courseId} group by date_format(date,'%Y%m') ORDER BY salesMonth ASC

select course_id, date_format(date,'%Y%m') AS salesMonth, count(*) AS count from class_room_schedule where course_id=#{courseId} and TIMESTAMP(date, start_time) >= NOW() group by date_format(date,'%Y%m') ORDER BY salesMonth ASC
select count(*) AS count from class_room_schedule where course_id=#{courseId} and TIMESTAMP(date, start_time) >= NOW() and schedule_status='OPEN'

select id, course_id, date, start_time, DATE_FORMAT(date,'%Y%m') as salesMonth from class_room_schedule where course_id=#{courseId} and TIMESTAMP(date, start_time) >= NOW() order by date ASC,start_time ASC
select course_id, course_term, allow_late_enrollment, tuition_fee, material_fee from course where course_id=#{courseId}
SELECT course_id, member_status FROM course_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY course_id ASC

course_id, target_month, monthly_tuition_fee, material_fee) values(

insert into course_history( member_id, member_status, course_id, late_enrollment, course_term, remaining_count, paid_tuition_fee, paid_material_fee, start_month) values( #{memberId}, #{memberStatus}, #{courseId}, #{lateEnrollment}, #{courseTerm}, #{remainingCount}, #{paidTuitionFee}, #{paidMaterialFee}, #{startMonth})

INSERT INTO member_schedule_status ( member_id, course_id, schedule_id, status, registered_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{courseId}, #{scheduleId}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW()
